_comment: EXAMPLE extra guard rules. No hook reads this file unless you write one that does — the installer copies it to policy/guard-rules.json on first run so the path exists. Each rule is {decision:'deny'|'ask', pattern:<regex>, message:<string>}; the pattern is matched by your hook, so regexes are fine here (unlike allowlist.json, whose globs are handed to the host verbatim). Note the escaping: in JSON, a regex word boundary is \\b and a literal dot is \\.

rules.message: write-method curl is denied by example rule. Use the dedicated API client for state-changing calls, or narrow the request to a read-only verb.
publishing a package is a one-way door: the version cannot be reused. Confirm the registry and the version first.
